pool.text: A battle was held at the Changlimithang sports ground in Thimphu.
The decision was made to shift the capital from Punakha to Thimphu.
The Royal Academy of Performing Arts was established in Thimphu.
The ancient capital city of Punakha was replaced by Thimphu.
Thimphu was officially declared the capital of the Kingdom of Bhutan.
The Royal Bhutan Police was established in Thimphu with personnel reassigned.
Kuensel was first started in Thimphu as a government bulletin.
The Royal Academy of Performing Arts was institutionalised as an academy.
The National Library was established and built in temple style.
Tashichho Dzong was converted into a monastic school with student monks.
The National Referral Hospital was established as the main hospital.
The Bhutan Broadcasting Service was established as a radio service.
The modern Changlimithang Stadium was built on the site in Thimphu.
A chorten was built in Thimphu to honour the 3rd King.
The Institute of Traditional Medicine was set up with WHO assistance.
A fingerprint bureau was established in Thimphu for specialized training.
The fourth king devolved all executive powers to a council.
The television broadcasts and satellite channels started during coronation.
The fourth king announced his decision to hand over reins.
A new shopping district opened between Doebum Lam and Norzim Lam.
